description: A button with gradient and neon styling.
howItWorks: Press and hold it to see the pressed state; let go and it returns.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Moody Bulldog 15</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by mrtqzbek11 - https://uiverse.io/mrtqzbek11/moody-bulldog-15 */
/* From Uiverse.io by mrtqzbek11 - Tags: gradient, button, active, neon */
button {
  width: 165px;
  height: 62px;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 17px;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  border: none;
  position: relative;
  background: #100720;
  transition: 0.1s;
}

button::after {
  content: '';
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-image: radial-gradient( circle farthest-corner at 10% 20%,  rgba(255,94,247,1) 17.8%, rgba(2,245,255,1) 100.2% );
  filter: blur(15px);
  z-index: -1;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
}

button:active {
  transform: scale(0.9) rotate(3deg);
  background: radial-gradient( circle farthest-corner at 10% 20%,  rgba(255,94,247,1) 17.8%, rgba(2,245,255,1) 100.2% );
  transition: 0.5s;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Hold that
</button>
</body>
</html>
